basics.name: Ozan Yusufoglu
basics.label: Software / Product Engineer
about: I'm a **software and product engineer** with a background in R&D and product design. I like researching complex domains and turning them into something people can understand, explore or use.

I studied Electrical & Electronics Engineering and spent eight years as an **R&D Manager**, coordinating grant-funded software projects in retail IoT, cybersecurity and digital broadcasting. It taught me that the real-world context around a problem matters as much as the technology.

Since 2024 I've been building full-stack indie products, from concept and UX through implementation. I also take on research and prototyping work: user research, domain and market research, and interactive prototypes. You'll find it on the [Work](/work) page.

I prototype and build products with **TypeScript**, **React** and **Next.js**, and use the Vercel AI SDK with the Anthropic API for agents. I'm drawn to data visualization, cartography and cognitive science, and enjoy working with people from multidisciplinary backgrounds.
basics.summary: Software and product engineer with a background in R&D and product design. Studied Electrical & Electronics Engineering and spent eight years as an R&D Manager coordinating grant-funded software projects in retail IoT, cybersecurity and digital broadcasting. Since 2024, building full-stack AI products independently, from concept and UX through implementation, and taking on user research, domain and market research, and interactive prototyping for clients. Primary stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, Anthropic API. Interested in data visualization, cartography and cognitive science.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Designed and built full-stack AI products independently, from concept and UX through implementation. Alongside, contracted user research, domain and market research, and interactive prototyping.
highlights: Indiehood and Monkeymind, both in live beta (see projects).
Client work for Yandex and for clients under NDA (see projects).

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Advised Yenihayat Informatics on its ongoing grant-funded projects through completion and final reporting.

work.name: Isoolate Cyber-Security
work.summary: Isoolate is an enterprise security platform providing browser isolation and manageability against critical web-borne threats. Carried out the early-phase R&D process and product development.
highlights: Took part successfully in ITU Innogate Startup Accelerator's 12th cohort as a promising cyber-security solution.

work.name: Yenihayat Informatics
work.summary: Coordinated multiple software projects supported by TÜBİTAK (The Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey, the national partner of the EU Horizon 2020 Programme in Turkey). Handled technical writing for R&D grants, coordinated the development team against the roadmap, drove product decisions to meet market needs, and managed technical and financial reporting of deliverables.
highlights: Secured financial resources for early-phase innovative products via successful R&D grant applications.
Guided MVPs through to proprietary industry solutions (see linked projects below).
Deployed a retail sales-monitoring IoT board to a pilot fleet of 200 devices across major Turkish cities.

projects.name: Indiehood
projects.description: A map-based social app for finding alternative events and communities nearby. Curators and users can feed a vision-AI pipeline that turns public social media posts into structured listings, which the community then extends and curates. Live beta in Istanbul.
highlights: Stack: React, Next.js, react-map-gl, Mapbox, Supabase, Framer Motion, Vercel AI SDK.

projects.name: Monkeymind
projects.description: A focus assistant, based on the Fogg Behavior Model, that breaks big goals into sessions and helps people build momentum. A UI-aware agent works alongside the user as a body double. Live beta on web and Android.
highlights: Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Framer Motion, Firebase, Vercel AI SDK, Anthropic API (earlier iterations also used OpenAI and Tiptap).

projects.name: Yandex Maps — User & Market Research
projects.description: Qualitative user and market research on how people in Türkiye use digital maps and discover places. 25 remote video interviews, synthesized into a research report.

projects.name: Shadow-AI Governance — Domain & Market Research
projects.description: Two interactive prototypes on shadow-AI risk: an EU AI Act & GDPR glossary drawn as a knowledge graph of connected legal concepts, and a flow-based playground for configuring data flows, protection layers, and scenarios, with an AI-assisted interface backed by a rule engine.
highlights: EU AI Act & GDPR Glossary: https://eu-ai-act-glossary.vercel.app/

projects.name: Cross-border Payment Corridor — Domain & Market Research
projects.description: Discovery for a regional cross-border payment corridor carrying person-to-person transfers one way and business payments the other, so most value nets out before cross-border settlement. Mapped licence scopes, instant-payment and A2A rails, and compliance responsibilities on both sides, and designed a reference architecture for one corridor platform shared by consumer, merchant and partner channels.

projects.name: KUKO Leipzig Event Site
projects.description: Kültür Kollektiv Leipzig e.V. — Association for transcultural change of perspective, encounter and exchange with people, languages, literatures, cultures, art and music from Turkey in Leipzig.

projects.name: Browser Virtualization Protocol for Seamless Data Security
projects.description: Browser isolation is a paradigm-shifting technology replacing traditional cyber security measures by virtualizing browsers on remote servers and streaming only the video output to the user with seamless remote control.
highlights: Funded under the TÜBİTAK 1507 R&D Programme.

projects.name: Sales Monitoring Platform for Fast Moving Consumer Goods
projects.description: ESM is a retail sales monitoring platform enabling real-time sales data aggregation from legacy POS systems through a low-cost, machine/software-agnostic IoT embedded board — eliminating manual data collection, human error, and delayed time cost. Actively involved in the pilot deployment of 200 devices across major Turkish cities.
highlights: Key learning: the significance of the human factor in real-world deployments, and designing interaction and technology together.

projects.name: Cloud-based Point-of-Sale Application for IoT Ready Platform
projects.description: Retail management platform and cloud-based point-of-sale application running on Beko 520TR IoT Ready hardware, integrated with new-generation cash registers per new Turkish law. Built in cooperation with Arçelik A.Ş.
highlights: Funded under the TÜBİTAK 1507 R&D Programme.

projects.name: High-density DVB-IP Transmodulator Appliance
projects.description: Scalable and modular digital headend platform featuring trans-modulation between QPSK/QAM and IP television sources, with PID analysis and filtering.
highlights: Funded under the TÜBİTAK 1507 R&D Programme.

projects.name: DVB-IP Streamer Middleware Platform for Hospitality
projects.description: All-in-one IPTV streaming platform capable of QPSK demodulation and MPTS, set-top box & user management, VoD, and digital services over STB.
highlights: Funded under the KOSGEB R&D SME Grant Program 2013.33.
